prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1171; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows damage concentrated on the front driver-side corner, including a cracked bumper cover, a broken headlamp assembly, and a bent hood edge with a torn fender liner. Most of these marks line up with a left-turn collision as described, and the pattern points to a single point of contact rather than scattered wear. The labor hours listed fit the work needed to restore the panels and align the sensors. Two similar charges entered on the same day are being verified against the invoices before approval. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from our records or the owner's account. Repair can proceed once the flagged charges are cleared.
